description: Mohammad / Mohammed / Muhammad; Hosseini / Husseini / Hoseini. Different translators at different times produce different spellings of the same name.
Credential evaluators, banks and background-check firms match on name. A mismatch turns an automated check into a manual one, adding weeks.
Iranian identity documents foreground the father's name; many Western forms have no field for it, so it lands inconsistently in middle-name fields and propagates the mismatch.
